message.content:
**Battle of Stalingrad (1942–1943)** | Aspect | Details | |--------|---------| | **Main Participants** | • **Soviet Union** – Red Army, commanded by General Fyodor K. Kharitonov (later General Vasily Zhukov).
• **Nazi Germany** – Army Group South, led by Field Marshal Friedrich K. H. von Rosenberg (later General Fedor von Bock). | | **Location** | The city of **Stalingrad** (now Volgograd) on the **Volga River** in southern Russia. The battle took place in and around the city, encompassing its industrial zones, the Volga River banks, and the surrounding countryside. | The confrontation became one of the deadliest and most pivotal battles of World War II, ultimately turning the tide in favor of the Allies on the Eastern Front.
